instances.description: Lattice iCEstick (iCE40-HX1K-TQ144). FT2232H has stock EEPROM (no programmed iSerial); disambiguated against the HX8K-B-EVN by descriptor on the libftd2xx side and by 'no serial' on the pyserial side.

Lattice iCE40-HX8K-B-EVN breakout (iCE40HX8K-CT256). FT2232H has a programmed EEPROM with iSerial FTB5Z4FJ and product 'USB <-> Serial Converter'. Same MPSSE wiring family as the iCEstick -- the program op's SPI-NOR opcode set is generic enough for both flash chips (Micron N25Q032 on hx1k, M25P80 on hx8k).
Custom STM32MP135 PCB. UART exposed via a USB-to-RS232 cable (FT232R, iSerial FTEKT7BP). No DFU/MSC instances configured for this board yet.
STM32MP257F-DK Discovery Kit, primary STLink-V3 VCP (interface MI_01 -> first console UART). STLink iSerial 0024003D4142501320353451.
STM32MP257F-DK Discovery Kit, second STLink-V3 VCP (interface MI_04 -> second UART). STLink iSerial 0024003D4142501320353451.
Custom STM32MP135 PCB (SRS-built). iSerial 002500085113 -- prefix matches the dfu.custom chip-UID.

STM32MP257F-DK baremetal MSC bootloader -- NOT YET IMPLEMENTED. This instance is a CONTRACT for the bootloader agent: make the MSC gadget enumerate with exactly these descriptors and the bench probe will bind it automatically (kernel usb-storage -> /dev/sdX). VID 0x0483 (ST), PID 0x571d (same baremetal-MSC function id as the MP135 boards; disambiguated from msc.custom by iSerial). iSerial 002600224C42501400313951 is the MP257 SoC chip-UID, identical to its ROM DFU iSerial (dfu.mp257) so the gadget can present the factory UID verbatim. block_size 512. If the implementation lands with a different PID/serial/block size, update these three fields to match the live descriptors.
Custom STM32MP135 PCB's ROM DFU bootloader. iSerial 002500083133511332303636.

STM32MP257F-DK Discovery Kit's ROM DFU bootloader. iSerial 002600224C42501400313951 (chip UID); DFU descriptor reports Device ID 0x505 = STM32MP25x family, distinguishing it from the MP13x (0x501) boards.
STM32MP135F-DK Linux USBTMC gadget. Present only when the EVB Linux image exposes the USBTMC function.
STM32MP257F-DK Discovery Kit over Ethernet (root login). NOTE: id kept as 'evb' for plan compatibility, but this is now the MP257, not the retired MP135F-DK eval board.
